انتقعنا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَعْنَا (intaqaʕnā) /in.ta.qaʕ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# اُنْتُقِعْنَا (untuqiʕnā) /un.tu.qiʕ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
